name: Cheech & Chong - Live Resin 3.5g - Snowballz
description:
Fresh-frozen flavor, straight from the jar. Cheech & Chong Snowballz live resin delivers 3.5 grams of full-spectrum concentrate, extracted from fresh-frozen flower to lock in the terpenes and aroma the plant started with — bold, flavorful, and made for dabbing.

Snowballz brings a cool, creamy profile: sweet vanilla and soft coconut notes up front, layered with a crisp minty edge and a smooth, subtly gassy finish. Because it's live resin, every dab hits with deeper flavor and a fuller, more well-rounded effect than standard extracts — potent, aromatic, and built for concentrate lovers.

Why you'll love it:

3.5G live resin — fresh-frozen extraction for maximum terpene preservation
Full-spectrum flavor — rich, aromatic, and true to the strain
Signature Snowballz flavor — sweet vanilla and coconut with a cool, crisp mint finish
Jar packaging — easy to scoop, easy to store, ready to dab
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Big flavor, premium potency, and true-to-plant character in every gram. Cheech & Chong Snowballz is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets. Requires a compatible dab rig or vaporizer.
